decisions.reason: Because this formwork profile system is very close to the firm's core formwork and plant-engineering knowledge, was given its own page, and fits an expanding R&D-oriented business, management would likely retain it and refine it rather than exit quickly.

This automated flow-control product builds directly on the firm's automation capabilities and strategic push toward more automated factories, so despite only being mentioned on the website it is still likely to be kept as a learnable extension of the core offer.

The shuttering magnet block is related to the firm's established formwork competence, but the lower website prominence suggests a somewhat weaker commitment or traction, making it more at risk than the more prominently presented products while still more likely kept than dropped.

Magnetic formwork strips are closely tied to the firm's existing modular formwork knowledge and were presented on their own page, which indicates sufficient strategic fit and commercial intent to keep them on the market.
This magnetic formwork component sits squarely within the firm's established knowledge base and was prominently presented, so absorptive capacity is high and the product is likely to be continued.

Although this magnetic formwork component is close to the firm's core expertise, its lesser website visibility and overlap with other magnetic formwork items make it the most exposed to rationalisation, yet still not the most likely outcome within a year.
